children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may bounce into a range of $5.37-1/4 to $5.39-3/4 per bushel, driven by a wave c.
As the third wave of a three-wave cycle from $5.23-1/4, this wave c may travel to the peak of the wave a around $5.39, assuming a flat pattern is developing.

Support is at $5.30-3/4, a break below which may trigger a fall into the $5.24-1/2 to $5.28 range. On the daily chart, the market seems to have stabilized around a support zone of $5.23-1/2 to $5.28-1/4.
The stabilization, along with the strong rise on Monday, indicates the formation of a flag pattern and a continuation of the uptrend from $4.57-1/4.
